title: Development workspace
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-4 met: counts come from the plan, schedule, facility and cost records and a failed read is a failure rather than zeroes; attention is derived from the review window and from a scheduled well without an approved program; each source link is decided by the page guard; and the landing route is the development persona's configured route.

dataModel.tables: FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE, FACILITY_INVESTMENT and DEVELOPMENT_COSTS, owned by DevelopmentPlanning; DRILLING_PROGRAM is read from DrillingAndConstruction only for the attention strip.
dataModel.noNewTables: DEV-01 is a read-only landing; it adds no table and no column. The four plan/schedule/facility/cost tables already exist and are registered by the DEVELOPMENT_PLANNING module.

implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/DevelopmentWorkspacePageView.cs (route 'development': KPI line, plans-by-state grid, spend, source buttons, attention strip)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgDevelopmentWorkspace), OgApplication.DevelopmentWorkspace, catalog 'development' (OgModuleKeys.Development), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/DevelopmentWorkspaceTests.cs (8, no database) + DevelopmentWorkspaceGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE, FACILITY_INVESTMENT, DEVELOPMENT_COSTS and DRILLING_PROGRAM, seeded in DevelopmentWorkspaceGatewayTests
integration.ac1_counts: F-1 shows 3 plans (APPROVED 1, DRAFT 2), 1 well planned, 1 drilling, 1 facility in construction and spend 115 USD + 20 EUR; a cost row dated after the as-of date is excluded and a null-total row is summed from its components
integration.ac2_attention: FDP-2 (submitted 61 days ago, DRAFT) is a PLAN_REVIEW item; WELL-1 (PLANNED, no approved program) is a PROGRAM_MISSING item; WELL-2's approved program and the completed WELL-3 are not attention
integration.ac3_links: with the gate allowing only 'wells', the wells link is available and fdpreview/welldesign/facilities/drillingprogram/construction are unavailable with the feature that adds them named
integration.ac4_route: OgPersonaLanding.RouteFor('/lifecycle/development/dashboard') is 'development', the catalog knows 'development', and the factory builds the page
integration.field_scope: loading with no field shows both fields (4 plans); loading F-1 shows 3
integration.attention_unavailable: after dropping DRILLING_PROGRAM the workspace still reads: AttentionAvailable=false, the note is set, plan attention remains, and program attention is absent rather than claiming every well is missing a program
integration.failed_read: after dropping FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN the workspace returns a failed result with a reference and no snapshot, never zero counts

gates.AC-1 Counts come from records; a failed: pass - every KPI is a Count or Sum over the read rows; the gateway test drops the plan table and sees a failure with no snapshot, and the unit test proves no connection is a failure rather than zeros.
gates.AC-2 Attention items are derived from da: pass - a submitted unapproved plan is attention only once it is past the 30-day review window; a scheduled (not finished) well with no approved program is attention. No attention flag is written.
gates.AC-3 Each source link is independently g: pass - BuildLinks calls the supplied page guard per route and gives the feature that adds an unavailable page; the gateway and unit tests both prove the per-route answer.
gates.AC-4 The landing route matches the perso: pass - the RBAC seed route '/lifecycle/development/dashboard' maps to 'development', which is a declared catalog route and is built by the page factory.

limits: FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN has no review-date column, so 'past their review date' is implemented as a submitted plan older than the 30-day review window and still not APPROVED; the window is a constant (ReviewWindowDays) and is stated rather than stored.
The 'facilities in construction' count is derived from PLANNED_START_DATE and PLANNED_COMPLETION_DATE, not from an investment-phase code.
Spend is TOTAL_DEVELOPMENT_COSTS (or the four cost components when the total is null) for cost rows dated on or before the asOf date, grouped by currency; the MM unit is the entity's own.
The source pages for DEV-02..DEV-05 and DEV-08 do not exist yet, so those links are shown unavailable with the feature that adds them; 'wells' is the only available source in this build.

The development persona's landing is the 'development' route when the persona mapping selects it; the app's role table still maps DrillingEngineer to wellpath and has no separate DevelopmentPlanner role, which is FND-07's policy to change.
The drilling-program table is read for the strip only; when it is absent the strip is hidden with a note rather than failing the workspace.
